title: Spark job execution internals
purpose: Driver planning, stage and task execution, native versus JVM operator routing, and observable fallback and failure behavior inside a Fabric Spark job.
accessibleSummary: Spark job execution internals. Driver builds the plan; Stages schedule tasks; Native operator route; JVM fallback route; Inspect fallback and failures.
longDescription: Driver planning, stage and task execution, native versus JVM operator routing, and observable fallback and failure behavior inside a Fabric Spark job.

nodes.label: Driver builds the plan
nodes.summary: The Spark driver analyzes transformations and produces an optimized physical plan.
nodes.detail: Dependencies divide the application into stages separated by exchanges.
nodes.whyItMatters: The plan is the map for both execution and diagnosis.

evidence.note: NEE receives Spark's optimized SQL physical plan while preserving optimizer behaviors.

drill.example: A join and aggregate become scan, exchange, and aggregation stages.
failureModes: Poor statistics produce an inefficient join plan.

nodes.label: Stages schedule tasks
nodes.summary: Each stage expands into tasks over input partitions and available executors.
nodes.detail: The scheduler coordinates dependencies and retries failed task attempts.
nodes.whyItMatters: Partition count and skew shape parallelism more than raw worker count.

evidence.note: Fabric pools provide driver and executor roles for Spark application execution.

drill.example: Two hundred partitions are scheduled across available executors.
failureModes: One skewed partition dominates stage duration.

nodes.label: Native operator route
nodes.summary: Gluten converts supported plan portions to Substrait and Velox executes vectorized C++ operators.
nodes.detail: Supported scans, joins, and expressions can remain columnar through a native segment.
nodes.whyItMatters: Native routing reduces JVM overhead without changing the whole Spark programming model.

evidence.note: Gluten translates supported Spark plan portions into Substrait for vectorized Velox execution.

drill.example: A supported filter and aggregation appear as native transformer operators.
failureModes: A numerical edge case differs from JVM behavior.

nodes.label: JVM fallback route
nodes.summary: Unsupported operators or features automatically execute with standard JVM Spark.
nodes.detail: Fallback preserves job correctness but removes native acceleration for that segment.
nodes.whyItMatters: A mixed plan must be inspected per operator, not labelled wholly native.

evidence.note: Unsupported operators, expressions, types, or features fall back to JVM Spark rather than failing the job.

drill.example: An unsupported expression runs on JVM between native scan and aggregate segments.

nodes.label: Inspect fallback and failures
nodes.summary: Spark UI, explain output, and execution telemetry reveal native operators, fallback, skew, and failed tasks.
nodes.detail: Engine choice and task health must be verified from the executed plan.
nodes.whyItMatters: Observability prevents unsupported assumptions about acceleration.

evidence.note: Spark UI and explain output identify native operators and JVM fallback.
Fabric monitoring can surface skew, memory pressure, cluster sizing, and failed-run evidence.

drill.example: The UI reveals repeated columnar-to-row transitions around one UDF.
failureModes: Only wall-clock duration is captured, leaving no actionable cause.
